name: teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams CLI MCP integration for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Check Teams status, read chats, and send messages from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Microsoft Teams through the unofficial teams-cli project. The plugin installs the latest teams-cli Windows x86_64 release on demand, exposes safe MCP tools for login/auth status, search, read, dry-run, send, channel posts, aliases, and cache management, and requires confirmation ids before write operations.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Teams is logged in.
Search Teams chats for a person or channel.
Read recent Teams messages from a resolved chat.
Dry-run and then send a Teams message after confirmation.
